introduction: ERC-1996 extends ERC-20 so a token balance can be placed on hold, reserving it to guarantee a future transfer. It was proposed by Julio Faura, Fernando Paris, and Daniel Lehrner in April 2019. A hold names a payer, payee, notary, value, and expiration; only the notary may execute it, while release is available to the notary or payee before expiration and to anyone after. Note: ERC-1996 is Stagnant — it has been inactive for 6+ months and may never be finalized, but remains historically or technically significant.
designPurpose: ERC-1996 was designed to guarantee a payment before it settles, something the ERC-20 approve function cannot do because an approved allowance is only a spending ceiling and the tokens stay freely transferable until they are spent. Holds solve this by locking the payer's balance the moment a hold is created, so the funds cannot move until the notary executes the hold, transferring up to the held value to the payee, or the hold is released back to the payer on expiration. The result behaves like an on-chain escrow.
commonUsage: Holdable tokens target settlement scenarios where a transfer must be assured before it completes: regulated tokens that clear a transfer after compliance checks pass, merchants that reserve funds before providing a service, and payments where the final amount is unknown so only part of the hold is executed. The interface also defines operator authorization, letting an approved account create holds for an owner, plus balanceOnHold and netBalanceOf queries that separate held funds from the spendable ERC-20 balance.
fn.hold.desc: Creates a hold on behalf of the caller in favor of the payee, locking value from the caller's balance until a notary executes or releases it. Reverts if the operationId has already been used.
fn.hold.params.operationId: The unique ID that identifies the hold.
fn.hold.params.to: The payee address that receives the tokens if the hold is executed.
fn.hold.params.notary: The address allowed to decide whether the hold is executed or released.
fn.hold.params.value: The maximum amount to transfer; must not exceed the payer's balance.
fn.hold.params.timeToExpiration: The duration until the hold expires; 0 makes the hold perpetual.
fn.hold.returns.success: True when the hold was created successfully.
fn.holdFrom.desc: Creates a hold on behalf of the payer in favor of the payee. The payer must have authorized the caller as a hold operator beforehand. Reverts if the operationId has already been used.
fn.holdFrom.params.operationId: The unique ID that identifies the hold.
fn.holdFrom.params.from: The payer address whose tokens are held and taken if the hold is executed.
fn.holdFrom.params.to: The payee address that receives the tokens if the hold is executed.
fn.holdFrom.params.notary: The address allowed to decide whether the hold is executed or released.
fn.holdFrom.params.value: The maximum amount to transfer; must not exceed the payer's balance.
fn.holdFrom.params.timeToExpiration: The duration until the hold expires; 0 makes the hold perpetual.
fn.holdFrom.returns.success: True when the hold was created successfully.
fn.executeHold.desc: Executes a hold, transferring the specified value from the payer to the payee. Any amount below the held value is released back to the payer. Only the notary may call it successfully.
fn.executeHold.params.operationId: The unique ID that identifies the hold.
fn.executeHold.params.value: The amount to transfer, which must be less than or equal to the held value.
fn.executeHold.returns.success: True when the hold was executed successfully.
fn.releaseHold.desc: Releases a hold without transferring, making the held amount available to the payer again. Before expiration only the notary or payee may release it; after expiration anyone may.
fn.releaseHold.params.operationId: The unique ID that identifies the hold.
fn.releaseHold.returns.success: True when the hold was released successfully.
fn.renewHold.desc: Renews a hold by setting a new expiration of the current block timestamp plus timeToExpiration, or making it perpetual when 0. Only the payer or an operator may renew, and only before the hold has expired.
fn.renewHold.params.operationId: The unique ID that identifies the hold.
fn.renewHold.params.timeToExpiration: The new duration until the hold expires, measured from the current block timestamp.
fn.renewHold.returns.success: True when the hold was renewed successfully.
fn.authorizeHoldOperator.desc: Approves an operator to create holds on behalf of the caller, mirroring the operator authorization pattern used by ERC-777.
fn.authorizeHoldOperator.params.operator: The address approved to issue holds for the caller.
fn.authorizeHoldOperator.returns.success: True when the operator was authorized successfully.
fn.balanceOnHold.desc: Returns how much of an account's balance is currently on hold and therefore unavailable for transfer.
fn.balanceOnHold.params.account: The address whose held balance is queried.
fn.balanceOnHold.returns.heldBalance: The amount of the account's balance that is currently on hold.
fn.HoldCreated.desc: Emitted when a hold is created, recording its payer, payee, notary, value, and expiration.
fn.HoldCreated.params.holdIssuer: The account that created the hold.
fn.HoldCreated.params.operationId: The unique ID that identifies the hold.
fn.HoldCreated.params.from: The payer whose tokens are held.
fn.HoldCreated.params.to: The payee who receives the tokens if executed.
fn.HoldCreated.params.notary: The notary who decides the hold's outcome.
fn.HoldCreated.params.value: The maximum amount placed on hold.
fn.HoldCreated.params.expiration: The Unix timestamp when the hold expires.
fn.HoldExecuted.desc: Emitted when a notary executes a hold, reporting the originally held value and the amount actually transferred.
fn.HoldExecuted.params.holdIssuer: The account that created the hold.
fn.HoldExecuted.params.operationId: The unique ID that identifies the hold.
fn.HoldExecuted.params.notary: The notary who executed the hold.
fn.HoldExecuted.params.heldValue: The amount that was placed on hold at creation.
fn.HoldExecuted.params.transferredValue: The amount actually transferred to the payee.
fn.HoldReleased.desc: Emitted when a hold is released without transfer, carrying the status code that identifies who released it.
fn.HoldReleased.params.holdIssuer: The account that created the hold.
fn.HoldReleased.params.operationId: The unique ID that identifies the hold.
fn.HoldReleased.params.status: The status code indicating how the hold was released.
sim.holdWalkthrough.name: Hold and Execute Walkthrough
sim.holdWalkthrough.desc: Follow a hold from creation by the payer through the notary's execution and the resulting token transfer to the payee.
sim.holdWalkthrough.step.hold: The hold issuer calls hold(operationId, to, notary, value, timeToExpiration) to reserve tokens in favor of the payee.
sim.holdWalkthrough.step.create: The contract records the new hold and moves the value from the issuer's spendable balance into its held balance, so it can no longer be transferred.
sim.holdWalkthrough.step.execute: The notary calls executeHold, and the contract transfers the held value from the payer to the payee, closing the hold.
sim.holdWalkthrough.step.event: The contract emits HoldExecuted with the held and transferred amounts so indexers can record the settlement.
